name: Residence Permit for Family Reunification

requirement_groups.name: Spouse (or cohabiting partner with a shared child) of a Romanian citizen

requirements.blocker_text: Married to (or a cohabiting partner with a shared child with) a Romanian citizen.

requirement_groups.name: Family member of a non-EU/EEA long-stay sponsor

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or family member of a non-EU/EEA citizen holding long-stay status in Romania.

outcome.duration_length: up to 5 years for spouses/family members of Romanian citizens or long-stay sponsors

sources.title: General Inspectorate for Immigration (IGI), Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs -- residence permit for family members: spouse/cohabiting partner with shared child, children, and first-degree relatives (parents/grandparents) of Romanian citizens; family members of non-EU/EEA sponsors; up to 5-year duration for family of Romanian citizens/long-stay sponsors; independent 6-month permits available for former family-reunification holders; 30-day processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Romania). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 IGI sourced. Three distinct requirement groups modeled (OR logic) reflecting genuinely different qualifying relationships the source lists: spouse/partner of a Romanian citizen, child of a Romanian citizen, and family member of a non-EU/EEA long-stay sponsor (this last group covers reunification for third-country-national families generally, not just Romanian-citizen sponsors -- a broader category than most family-reunification files in this dataset). The source also describes first-degree relatives (parents/grandparents) of Romanian citizens as eligible but did not specify separate conditions from the spouse/child groups, so that category is not modeled as its own group here -- disclosed as a simplification. work_rights/family_can_work set to restricted/false as conservative defaults; the source did not state work rights for holders of this specific permit category. citizenship_after_months for the spouse-of-Romanian group is set to 60 (5yr) reflecting Article 8(1)(a)'s reduced residence period for spouses married to and cohabiting with a Romanian citizen (see ro_citizenship_by_marriage.json) -- this is a cross-file inference, not separately stated on this IGI page.
